summary: Complete testing of ProductPage feature. All core functionality working correctly: product display, theme switching (dark/light), quantity selector, add to cart for logged-in users, favorites toggle, share button (clipboard permission issue in headless browser - expected), back to catalog navigation.

ProductPage_display: Product image displayed with glassmorphism card
theme_switching: Theme toggle button (data-testid='guest-theme-toggle') visible for guests
Click toggles from dark to light theme
Click toggles from light to dark theme
Dark theme: zinc-950 background, orange-500 accents, orange add-to-cart button
Light theme: cyan-pink gradient background, teal/green accents, green add-to-cart button
Glassmorphism cards adapt to theme correctly
add_to_cart: Guest user: clicking add-to-cart redirects to login
Guest user: shows error toast 'Войдите для добавления в корзину'
Logged-in user: add-to-cart adds product with correct quantity
Logged-in user: shows success toast with product name and quantity
Cart badge in header updates after adding
favorites_button: Initial state shows 'В избранное' with empty heart
Click adds to favorites, toast shows 'Добавлено в избранное'
After adding, button shows 'В избранном' with filled red heart
share_button: Click attempts to copy URL to clipboard
Note: Clipboard write failed in headless browser (security restriction) - works in real browsers
backend_api: GET /api/products/{id} returns product details (14/14 tests passed)

critical_code_review_comments: ProductPage.js properly handles loading and error states
Theme context correctly applied across all elements
Glassmorphism design consistent with rest of app
data-testid attributes present on all interactive elements
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProductPage feature fully tested. Test product ID: 8cd5b1c5-7980-4765-9db9-8e309614f8c5. Theme toggle uses guest-theme-toggle for non-auth users, theme-toggle for logged-in users. CatalogPage uses modal for product quick view, not ProductCard component navigation. PopularProducts on homepage links to catalog search, not directly to ProductPage.

notes.catalog_vs_product_page: CatalogPage has its own inline ProductCard that opens a modal for quick view. The imported ProductCard component from /components/ProductCard.js uses Link to navigate to /product/:id but it's not used in CatalogPage.
notes.share_clipboard: Share button clipboard.writeText fails in headless Playwright due to secure context/permission restrictions. This is expected behavior - will work in real browsers with HTTPS.
notes.mocked_apis: Prepayment topup and crypto payments are MOCKED as noted in original requirements
